tokens.name: sakura-red
tokens.usage: Brand colour: the logo mark and wordmark, headings, links and primary buttons. Text on cream (10.1:1) and blush (7.8:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground and the light fill of cards. Text on it: ink, sakura-red, warm-charcoal, rose.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and UI text on cream and blush (14.5:1 on cream, 11.2:1 on blush).

tokens.name: warm-charcoal
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on cream (6.7:1) and blush (5.2:1).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft panels, input backgrounds and quiet highlights. Carries ink, warm-charcoal, sakura-red or rose text.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Small accent: highlights, icons, decorative marks, sale or notice text. Text on cream (5.8:1) and blush (4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-sakura-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sakura-red fill, such as primary buttons and the reversed logo (10.1:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero wordmark-style headline, one per page. sakura-red on cream.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page and section headlines, sentence case.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, form notes and legal text in warm-charcoal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, buttons and tags, set in capitals; echoes the NAILS line of the logo.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding inside inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between stacked items.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding and the petal-pattern pitch.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons; half the short side of the control.
